voice.summary: Sounds like a developer-friendly billing page: it shows the math and keeps the promises small. Every price is per 1,000 requests, every tier is visible and the savings are real figures.
dos: Show the unit price and the total together
Name tiers and show the cost of each
State the annual saving in percent
donts: Do not use vague phrases like custom pricing

taglines: See the bill before you build
Usage pricing that adds up honestly
boilerplate: Pingwell is an API for sending messages priced per 1,000 requests, with no seats and no minimums, so teams can see exactly what each tier costs before they grow.

microcopy.success: Plan selected. Your estimate is updated.
microcopy.error: Couldn't calculate. Enter a number between 10K and 10M.
microcopy.empty: Move the slider to see your price.

logo.note: A bolt suggests the speed of a ping and a single quick request.
